sentences.text: Shri Umakant Sharma - Senior Advocate with Shri Vikarn Sin  the applicants.
Shri A.N. Gupta - learned Government Advocate for the resp  ORDER

This is first application filed under Section 482 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail on behalf of applicants Omkar Das & Deendayal Das @ Dipakdas, who are apprehending their arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.45/2015 dated 10.05.2015 registered at Police Station Nayagaon,
district Satna, for the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of IPC.

This first anticipatory bail application has been filed under Section 482 of B.N.S.S., 2023, but,
learned counsel for the State has raised preliminary objection that without approaching the Court below, this anticipatory application has been filed directly before this Court.

No doubt, this court has concurrent jurisdiction to entertain anticipatory bail application along with Court of Sessions Judge but, common legal practice is that the application for seeking anticipatory should 2 MCRC-30235-2025 ordinarily be filed before the Sessions Court at the first instance and not directly before the High Court.
The practice of various High Courts in this regard has been discussed at length in the case of Hare Ram Sharma Vs. State of Chattisgarh, 2021 Cr.L.J. 3535.

entities.text: Hare Ram Sharma Vs. State of Chattisgarh, 2021 Cr.L.J. 3535
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Taking the aforesaid legal proposition into consideration, this anticipatory bail application is rejected.
The applicants may approach the Sessions Judge, if so advised, for this relief of anticipatory bail.
This application is accordingly disposed of.
